dedupe_keys.name: arctic ship evacuation expert judgments and consequence scenarios

description: This workbook collects expert judgments used to develop consequence scenarios for ship evacuations in Arctic waters. Memorial University of Newfoundland and National Research Council of Canada researchers interviewed and surveyed sixteen maritime, policy and research experts. Twenty-seven worksheets contain thematic code definitions, reference and intersection counts, and survey responses. Nineteen evacuation scenarios were assessed for five ship types, using ordinal influence, likelihood and consequence scales. Mendeley provides the XLSX workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Geographic scope is Arctic maritime operations; calendar interview dates were not established here. Expert elicitation and ordinal ratings are limitations when interpreting these inputs as observed casualty rates or calibrated probabilities. Modellers could structure evacuation scenarios or explore uncertainty in rescue and survival assumptions. model-jupedsim is related to movement simulation but requires separate maritime and survival components. No interview transcript, participant response row or model executable was downloaded. The conceptual consequence model was not reconstructed or validated.
